title: Complex charge-labelled U(1) MPS state representation
execution_status: U1 MPS core, exact charge-block factorization/splitting, truncation diagnostics, mixed-canonical gauge receipts, canonical-gauge-weighted global TEBD truncation ledger, analytic U1 two-site Hamiltonian exponentiation, second-order Strang stepper and transfer-environment step-doubling diagnostic are source-authored. Exact-head Rust 1.96 harness pending.
claim_ceiling: Step-doubling Richardson diagnostic is asymptotic, not a formal Trotter theorem. Hamiltonian projection, truncation/canonicalization and coarse/fine product-formula defects are separately recorded. No total physical error proof, interval arithmetic, SOTA performance or quantum-advantage claim.

conventions.left_boundary: single virtual state with charge zero
conventions.right_boundary: single virtual state with declared total charge

dense_to_mps.method: Sequential charge-block SVD at each cut, grouped by intermediate prefix charge q and suffix charge K-q.
dense_to_mps.truncation: No bond cap or positive singular-value cutoff. Exactly-zero singular directions are omitted as nullspace; every positive singular value is retained.
dense_to_mps.explicit_nonclaim: No two-site gate evolution or TEBD yet.

two_site_gates.gate_convention: Complex 4x4 row-major matrix in basis |00>, |01>, |10>, |11>; may mix |01> and |10>, but must not couple different total excitation sectors.
validations: two-site virtual charge selection rule after application
two_site_gates.claim_ceiling: Exact two-site contraction and gate application only; no charge-block SVD split or TEBD yet.

two_site_split.method: For each intermediate prefix charge q, factor the submatrix whose rows satisfy q_left+s1=q and columns satisfy q_right=q+s2. Independent complex SVD per q block.
two_site_split.truncation: No positive cutoff or bond cap. Omit exactly-zero singular directions only; retain every positive singular value.
two_site_split.claim_ceiling: Exact charge-block two-site SVD split only. No approximate truncation policy or TEBD yet.

policy.max_bond_dimension: Global across all admissible charge sectors.
policy.relative_singular_value_cutoff: Keep sigma_i >= relative_cutoff * sigma_max, where cutoff lies in [0,1].
policy.order: Apply relative cutoff first, then global bond cap to remaining singular values ranked descending across all sectors.

truncation.claim_ceiling: Local two-site approximate compression only; full TEBD scheduler and end-to-end circuit fidelity/error guarantee remain pending.

assumptions: each truncation is an orthogonal Schmidt projection

tebd_layer_scheduler.schedule: Single parity layer; parity 0 uses bonds 0,2,4,..., parity 1 uses bonds 1,3,5,...; bonds sorted ascending and unique.
tebd_layer_scheduler.execution: Each disjoint bond applies validated U1 unitary, charge-block split and explicit global truncation policy; updates complete MPS and revalidates charge/boundaries.
tebd_layer_scheduler.reason: A local discarded Schmidt weight is not a global state-vector residual for arbitrary MPS gauge. Require mixed-canonical exterior isometry at every truncated bond, verified by a canonicalization receipt, before upgrading sum sqrt(w_j) to a global L2 bound.
nonclaims: no second-order Strang even/odd/even TEBD time stepper

canonical_gauge.method: Charge-block SVD left sweep on sites [0,bond), right sweep on sites (bond+1,N). Retain all positive singular values; omit exact zeros only. Rebuild a candidate MPS transactionally before replacing the original.
canonical_gauge.state_equivalence: The L2 state-reconstruction residual is computed using the cross-MPS overlap contraction, not by dense expansion, and supports different virtual bond dimensions.
canonical_gauge.error_bound: For a passing receipt, each site's Gram residual r bounds its physical-to-virtual map norm by sqrt(1+r). The product of site bounds gives conservative exterior map operator-norm upper bounds. Multiply local discarded Schmidt norm by the left/right exterior product and add the measured canonicalization state-reconstruction L2 residual.
canonical_gauge.claim_ceiling: Gauge sweeps and receipt only. Global TEBD error certification remains disabled until every gate truncation is integrated with and checks a receipt.

tebd_global_error_ledger.integration: Before each gate, the current MPS is canonicalized around that two-site bond. The gate is applied to the center pair, then explicit truncation is performed. Each receipt is stored alongside the corresponding gate truncation.
assumptions: each physical gate is unitary and charge-conserving
each local truncation is an orthogonal Schmidt projection in the measured mixed-canonical gauge
canonicalization state reconstruction residual is included explicitly
all canonical gauge receipts pass and match the gate bond, site count and total charge
tebd_global_error_ledger.invalidation: Any missing, mismatched or failed receipt clears the cumulative global bound and permanently invalidates qualification for that layer. Local discarded-weight receipts remain available.
tebd_global_error_ledger.claim_ceiling: The code computes a conservative candidate bound; no global error claim is qualified until the new exact-head harness and dense sequential-circuit oracle tests pass.

hamiltonian.structure: Hermitian 1 ⊕ 2 ⊕ 1 block structure under total excitation number.
hamiltonian.exponentiation: Analytic exponential of two 1x1 sectors and Hermitian 2x2 single-excitation sector; output is revalidated as a unitary U(1)-preserving gate.

projection_receipt.projection: Frobenius difference between supplied two-site Hamiltonian and the block-Hermitian U(1)-conserving matrix actually exponentiated. The |01>,|10> coupling is symmetrized before exponentiation.

strang_time_stepper.error_boundary: Global truncation bound covers only canonical-gauge-qualified compression contributions under unitary gates/no renormalization. Product-formula Trotter error is explicitly not bounded; trotter_error_bound=None and trotter_error_qualified=false.

step_doubling.method: Compute coarse one-step result at dt, fine two-step result at dt/2, and L2 distance through transfer-environment overlaps; no dense conversion needed.
step_doubling.interpretation: Asymptotic Richardson estimate only; not a formal Trotter upper theorem. Contamination from both coarse/fine compression is added rather than misreported as product-formula error.

competitive_baseline_matrix.differentiator: Per-gate charge-sector and canonical-gauge receipts; a dense sequential-circuit falsification of the global truncation bound; analytic block Hamiltonian exponentiation; separate truncation and Trotter status. MPS/QN/TEBD capability itself is not novel.

proposed_targets.dense_oracle_global_truncation: measured dense state-vector residual <= canonical-gauge global truncation bound + documented floating-point allowance
proposed_targets.performance: At equal measured state error, target >=20% lower runtime OR peak memory on a preregistered U(1)-dominated workload versus best Quimb and ITensor configuration
proposed_targets.note: All targets are prospective, not achieved results.
